summary: John Hancock Comvest Private Income Fund, a BDC, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing routine monthly dividend declarations for Class I shares ($0.1871 per share, 8.96% annualized yield), NAV figures as of July 31, 2026, and continuous offering status. Dividends payable September 24, 2026, to shareholders of record August 28, 2026. This is a routine operational disclosure with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or tender offer.
